content:
tom_sales: Quick heads-up 10: ACME Security wants a compact deliverable: EU-only dataflow diagram, list of subprocessors (with which data classes they touch), and a short SI G/CAIQ-style blurb about encryption and segmentation. Deadline: tomorrow morning. Can we do a small bundle?

nina_solutions: Yup. Ill create a simplified DFD (PNG), a CSV for subprocessors with columns: name, role, data_categories, region, contracted_eu_residency. Also a 1-paragraph CAIQ-friendly answer.

patrick_sec: Important constraints they emphasized: PII must never leave the EU (no cross-border backups), KMS keys must be EU-controlled or customer-managed, telemetry may be aggregated and stored EU-only. Recommend Dedicated or Private. Hosted can work only with explicit no-fallback routing and EU-only storage enabled.

emma_legal: When you post the subprocessors, add an "opt-in notification" clause example: "We will notify Customer 30 days before onboarding any new subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may reasonably object." I'll adapt for DPA.

nina_solutions: Draft routing snippet for Hosted pinned to EU (no fallback):
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: hosted
  region_policy:
    allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
    allow_fallback: false
storage:
  backups:
    cross_region: false
    retention_region: eu-central-1
cache:
  persistent_kv: false
```

nina_solutions: Subprocessor CSV (summary rows):
- Google Cloud (compute/storage): infra, stores encrypted blobs, EU zones only for this config
- Datadog (monitoring): collects metrics, EU tenant available, metrics pseudonymized
- Sentry (errors): error traces with PII scrubber enabled, EU hosts
- Zendesk (support): ticket metadata, EU residency flag set per contract
- HashiCorp Vault / Customer KMS: key management (customer option)
- Log pipeline: internal ELK cluster (s3 EU bucket)

patrick_sec: Add note: KV cache persistence is disabled on Hosted; Dedicated/Private can persist Redis in EU. Backups: disabled for PII. KMS rotation: recommended 90 days; access limited to escrow process documented in contract.

tom_sales: They also asked about CAIQ question: "Does the provider segregate customer data and encrypt keys under customer control?" Need a copy-paste answer for that field.

nina_solutions: Paste-ready answer: "Yes. Redwood enforces tenant-level logical segregation across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Encryption in transit uses TLS1.2+ and at-rest encryption is AES-256. Customers may supply and manage their own KMS keys (recommended) or use Redwood's HSM-backed KMS; key access is restricted and logged. For Dedicated and Private deployments, network segmentation is implemented at the VPC level; for Hosted, we enforce strict routing and per-tenant isolation with optional VPC peering."

emma_legal: Good. I'll add: "Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 mappings to CAIQ controls; specific evidence can be provided under NDA."

redwood-bot: asset uploaded: /internal/security/dfd/1769758420-acme-eu-dfd.png (sha256:fa12bd34cdef)

nina_solutions: Uploaded DFD. I'm going to export the CSV and short CAIQ doc and drop here in ~4 hours. Also adding a short pricing note for their 50 RPS expected load: Hosted (EU pin, reserved burst): baseline list price X, estimated cost: $X/mo; Dedicated (EU-only reserved capacity): ~+40-50% over Hosted for guaranteed isolation and throughput; Private on-prem: separate SOW (one-time infra/setup + ongoing support). I'll put concrete numbers in the deliverable.

patrick_sec: Also highlight: logs containing PII are redacted before export; audit logs are retained per customer retention policy and can be stored in EU-only buckets.

nina_solutions: Checklist updated:
- [x] Confirmed EU-only constraints
- [x] DFD PNG uploaded (see redwood-bot)
- [ ] Subprocessor CSV to post
- [ ] CAIQ short answers doc to post
- [ ] Pricing delta note to post
- [ ] Legal clause sample (emma_legal)

tom_sales: Thanks team 64f. Once the bundle is here I'll forward to ACME-security and coordinate follow-up. If they push for evidence, loop legal/security and I'll set up NDA path.
